svg.title: DisputeDesk
svg.desc: DisputeDesk: Agents draft, code decides, and a person signs the large ones. Evidence: 349 tests 99 of them attacks on the approval gate; $500 auto-file limit; above it the FinOps lead signs; HMAC chain audit chain checked before every money call. Status: prototype.
